originals.text: Big city, bigger heart.
A sandwich ain't charity. It's respect.
Feed the block, and the block feeds back.
Nobody should go hungry in the city that never sleeps.
The block takes care of its own.
Your dollar didn't disappear. It turned into some good.
Hunger don't check zip codes.
Real New Yorkers look out for each other.
Hustle for the block, not just for yourself.
Kindness is the realest flex in New York.
You can't fix everything. But you can feed somebody.
Hunger don't take the night off, and neither does hope.
Every neighbor counts, housed or not.
Small bills, big impact.
Pay it forward, one plate at a time.
Show love like it's rush hour: everywhere, all at once.
One block fed is one block stronger.
Good food, good people, good deeds.
When the block eats, the city wins.
Give like a New Yorker: fast, loud, and from the heart.
